title: register_custom_instance_class<T>() ignores disabled classes from build profiles
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot 4.7.2-stable, commit `ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079`.
- I have not built current `master`, but its `ClassDB::register_custom_instance_class<T>()` implementation is still unconditional at the time of filing.

### System information

Windows x86_64, custom `template_release` build with MSVC, using a feature build profile.

### Issue description

Classes disabled by a feature build profile are normally skipped by the `GDREGISTER_*` registration macros, which check `GD_IS_CLASS_ENABLED(T)`.

`ClassDB::register_custom_instance_class<T>()` does not perform that check. As a result, classes registered through this helper remain exposed in ClassDB even when they are listed in `disabled_classes`.

For example, disabling `HTTPClient` still results in:

```gdscript
ClassDB.class_exists("HTTPClient") == true
```

The same helper is currently used for `HTTPClient`, `StreamPeerTLS`, `PacketPeerDTLS`, and `DTLSServer`.

The generated `core/disabled_classes.gen.h` is correct and specializes `is_class_enabled<HTTPClient>` to `std::false_type`; the build-profile input and generated trait are therefore working as intended. The missing check is localized to `register_custom_instance_class<T>()`.

Expected behavior: a class listed in `disabled_classes` should not be exposed or reported by `ClassDB.class_exists()`, regardless of the ClassDB registration helper used.

Actual behavior: custom-instance classes remain registered and exposed.

I verified the following generic guard locally:

```cpp
template <typename T>
static void register_custom_instance_class() {
	if constexpr (GD_IS_CLASS_ENABLED(T)) {
		// Existing function body.
	}
}
```

With this guard, `ClassDB.class_exists("HTTPClient")` becomes `false`, the custom Windows template builds successfully, and the exported project starts and passes its smoke tests.

Relevant source:

- [`core/object/class_db.h`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/core/object/class_db.h)
- [`core/register_core_types.cpp`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/core/register_core_types.cpp)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create `httpclient.gdbuild`:

```json
{
  "type": "build_profile",
  "disabled_classes": ["HTTPClient"],
  "disabled_build_options": {}
}
```

2. Build an export template with the profile, for example:

```text
scons platform=windows target=template_release arch=x86_64 build_profile=httpclient.gdbuild
```

3. Export or run a project with that template and evaluate:

```gdscript
print(ClassDB.class_exists("HTTPClient"))
```

4. The unmodified engine prints `true`. The expected result is `false`.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The build profile and one-line ClassDB check above are the minimal reproduction; no project assets are required.
